name: Compose AI
tagline: AI autocomplete and writing assistance inline across Gmail, Docs, and the web.
description: Compose AI is a browser extension that adds AI-powered autocomplete and text generation directly into the fields you already type in — Gmail, Google Docs, and most web apps. It finishes sentences as you write, drafts full emails from a one-line instruction, rephrases text, and supports custom shortcuts to expand snippets. The core extension is free, with a premium tier for personalization features.
edge: Lives inline as autocomplete wherever you type — Gmail, Docs, the web — rather than a separate chat window you copy answers out of.
pros: Drafts full emails from one instruction
cons: Best for short-form writing, not long docs
